criteria.LINE_HW: handwritten text organized in a tabular or form-like structure
criteria.LINE_P: printed text organized in a tabular or form-like structure
criteria.LINE_T: machine-typed text organized in a tabular or form-like structure

criteria.PHOTO_L: photos presented within a table-like layout or accompanied by tabular annotations
criteria.TEXT: mixtures of printed, handwritten, and/or typed text, potentially with minor graphical elements
criteria.TEXT_HW: only handwritten text in paragraph or block form (non-tabular)
criteria.TEXT_P: only printed text in paragraph or block form (non-tabular)
criteria.TEXT_T: only machine-typed text in paragraph or block form (non-tabular)
